title: feat: enforce per-session turn/spend limit with 75%/90% notices (ENG-2812)
body:
## Risk: Medium | Priority: Urgent

## What was wrong (before)
Nothing capped how many model turns or dollars one agent session could use. Opiner session `aea6a0ee…` ran 549 turns (~$47) of an $80 Starter allowance with no warning. The ENG-2953 shadow only logged in-process "would pause" lines.

## What this fixes (after)
Every agent-loop model call is counted on the session item (atomic ADD, survives deploys/instances). When a session's window is used up the loop stops **before its next model call** and the session waits: a person replies "continue" to open a fresh window; an unattended scheduled run stays paused (`terminationReason: 'session_limit'`). At 75% and 90% of a window the in-app reply gets a one-time notice.

**Caps (owner decision 2026-11-24):** 150 turns / $20 per window at the $80 Starter allowance, scaled by the tier's live `llmUsagePolicy.hardCostThresholdMicroUsd`, never below baseline. Live prod config gives: Free 150/$20, Starter 150/$20, Pro 375/$50, Super Premium 375/$50, Max 1688/$225, Sandbox (legacy $500 allowance) 938/$125, Managed/Demo/Partner (no allowance) 150/$20. Derived in code from the existing tier config — **no pricing/limit config row is written**.

**Notice copy (owner-specified):** "You have used 75% of this session’s limit. Start a new session to keep going without interruption." (and 90%). In-app chat only: not on unattended runs or Slack sessions.

## Complexity ledger
- +~290 lines module, +~230 lines tests, ~+60 lines wiring. New moving parts: 6 optional numeric attributes on the existing AW-ChatSessions item (no table/index/GSI/backfill; same additive pattern as `activeRun`, ENG-110), one kill switch (`SESSION_LIMIT_ENFORCE=false`, default on because prod's EB env block is at its size cap).
- Behavior change is the issue's intent: pause + notices. Otherwise chat behavior is unchanged; every DynamoDB error fails open.
- Re-entry loops stopped on `pausedBySessionLimit`: media auto-continuation, work-plan auto-continuation, verified-chat attempt loop (main + completion-gate continuation), self-improve reflection.

## How to test
1. In a test session, set `sessionLimitTurns` to 149 on the AW-ChatSessions item (or chat until 150 model calls).
2. Send a message. **Expected**: the run stops before the next model call with "This session has reached its limit (150 of 150 steps and $X of $20.00 used). Reply "continue" …"; assistant metadata has `sessionLimitPaused`.
3. Send "what else?" **Expected**: same pause notice, no model call.
4. Send "continue". **Expected**: the turn runs normally; `sessionLimitWindowStartTurns` = current total.
5. At 113 turns into a window the reply ends with the 75% notice once; at 135 the 90% notice once.

## Edge cases to check
- Two simultaneous "continue" → one window (conditional write).
- Concurrent runs crossing 75% → notice shown once (conditional claim).
- Counter write failure → run still stops at its cap (local count).

## Test Evidence
- `npx jest --runTestsByPath src/services/__tests__/sessionLimit.test.ts`: 26 passed, 0 failed (on Atem).
- Local full/scoped `tsc` not run (scoped tsc pulls the whole graph and OOMs on this box's RAM); compile proof is CI's Backend build.

## Behavioral assertions verified
- "A replayed runaway session stops at the cap and waits for confirmation" → `replayed runaway session … stops at the cap, stays paused …, resumes on "continue"` (549-turn Opiner replay stops at 150; new tracker after "restart" still paused; non-confirmation stays paused).
- "Warnings fire once per threshold" → `75% / 90% notices` suite. Scope per owner decision 2026-11-24: per-session window thresholds, in-app chat only (no email). Monthly-allowance email warnings are not in this decision.

## Files changed
- `backend/src/services/sessionLimit.ts` (new)
- `backend/src/services/agentModeService.ts` (loop pause, counting, notice, return flag)
- `backend/src/services/generateMarketingResponseWorkerService.ts` (type)
- `backend/src/controllers/agentModeController.ts` (no auto-continue/retry on pause)
- `backend/src/utils/scheduledRunFailureReasons.ts`
- `backend/src/services/__tests__/sessionLimit.test.ts`
- `dev/pending/eng-2812-session-limit.md`

## What was NOT tested
- Not counted/paused: the owner's own Claude plan route (AgentWeb does not pay for those turns) and Live Voice.
- No portal UI change: confirmation is the typed reply "continue".
- Pause notice wording is mine (neutral, mirrors the approved notice); notice copy is the owner's.

## Rollback
Set `SESSION_LIMIT_ENFORCE=false` (no counting, no pause) or revert the PR. Leftover attributes are inert.

## Linear issue

Risk: Medium
Adds per-session turn and spend limits checked before each agent-loop model call. Caps scale with tier cost threshold. At the cap, unattended runs pause with `terminationReason: 'session_limit'`; attended users reply "continue" to open a new window. On by default; `SESSION_LIMIT_ENFORCE=false` disables it.

Reasoning: Default-on gating affects every agent run and can pause scheduled work. Rollback is one env flag. DynamoDB errors fail open, so storage faults do not block runs. A wrong pre-call pause would stall runs, which is the main outage-adjacent path.
